title: Fast Generative DeOcclusion for Visual Geometry and Robotics
summary: A fast geometry-aware generative de-occlusion framework that selects informative views, performs 2D amodal completion, and fuses the results through depth-aware 3D integration.

mechanisms.name: Depth-aware generative de-occlusion
mechanisms.description: Separate observed and occluded content, generate amodal hypotheses for hidden regions, and integrate them into a 3D representation with depth-aware fusion.
mechanisms.limitations: Generated hidden appearance or geometry is a hypothesis, not geometric truth, exact-instance authority, a visible-door measurement, or a confirmation source. BlindAssist may reuse the occlusion stratification but must never score generated completion as reference truth.
